A '''chemical converter''' was the basic component of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system's [[Atmospheric converter/Legends|atmosphere generator]] which took in waste elements such as [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]] from the vessel's crew and passengers. The unit converted them into usable materials to maintain life support functions. The converters could be either [[Biological converter|biological]] of [[Synthetic converter|synthetic]] in nature.<ref name="SWS" />
